blocks.prompt: 11 Solve the following trigonometric equation: \(\tan^{2}x - \left(\sqrt{3} + 1\right)\tan x = -\sqrt{3}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh \(\tan x\) mein quadratic equation hai, bas thori si chhupi hui hai. Pehle \(-\sqrt{3}\) ko left side par laayenge taa ke right side zero ho jaye.
Factorise ke liye aise do numbers chahiye jin ka sum \(\sqrt{3} + 1\) aur product \(\sqrt{3}\) ho: woh \(1\) aur \(\sqrt{3}\) hain.
Find kya karna hai? Principal solutions aur general solution.
Plan: factorise, \(\tan x = 1\) aur \(\tan x = \sqrt{3}\) hal karo, period \(\pi\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\tan^{2}x - \left(\sqrt{3} + 1\right)\tan x = -\sqrt{3}\).
Maloom karna: principal solutions aur general solution.
Tareeqa: isay \(\tan x\) mein quadratic \(= 0\) ki shakal mein likh kar factorise karenge.

Sab kuch ek taraf laayein
\[\tan^{2}x - \left(\sqrt{3} + 1\right)\tan x + \sqrt{3} = 0\]
Kyun: quadratic tabhi factorise hoti hai jab ek side zero ho. \(-\sqrt{3}\) left par aa kar \(+\sqrt{3}\) ban gaya.

Middle term torein
\[\tan^{2}x - \tan x - \sqrt{3}\tan x + \sqrt{3} = 0\]
\[\tan x(\tan x - 1) - \sqrt{3}(\tan x - 1) = 0\]
\[(\tan x - 1)\left(\tan x - \sqrt{3}\right) = 0\]
Kyun: 1 aur \(\sqrt{3}\) ka sum \(1 + \sqrt{3}\) aur product \(\sqrt{3}\) hai, isi liye middle term \(-\tan x - \sqrt{3}\tan x\) mein toota. Phir \((\tan x - 1)\) common nikla.
Dhyan dein: \(-\sqrt{3}(\tan x - 1) = -\sqrt{3}\tan x + \sqrt{3}\); sign dhyan se check karein.

Do basic equations
\[\tan x = 1\ \text{ or }\ \tan x = \sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: har factor zero. Dono values positive hain, is liye dono cases mein \(x\) quadrant I ya III mein hoga.

Jab \(\tan x = 1\) (reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{4}\))
\[x = \dfrac{\pi}{4}\]
\[x = \pi + \dfrac{\pi}{4} = \dfrac{5\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: table se \(\tan\frac{\pi}{4} = 1\); quadrant III ka angle \(\pi + \alpha\).

Jab \(\tan x = \sqrt{3}\) (reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{3}\))
\[x = \dfrac{\pi}{3}\]
\[x = \pi + \dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{4\pi}{3}\]
Kyun: table se \(\tan\frac{\pi}{3} = \sqrt{3}\).

General solution
Tangent ka period \(\pi\) hai:
\[\left\{\dfrac{\pi}{4} + n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{\pi}{3} + n\pi\right\},\ n \in \mathbb{Z}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{5\pi}{4} = \frac{\pi}{4} + \pi\) aur \(\frac{4\pi}{3} = \frac{\pi}{3} + \pi\); har case ki doosri value pehli value ki family mein hi aa jati hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\tan x = 1:\ 1 - (\sqrt{3} + 1) = -\sqrt{3}\]
\[\tan x = \sqrt{3}:\ 3 - (3 + \sqrt{3}) = -\sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: doosri line mein \(\left(\sqrt{3} + 1\right)\sqrt{3} = 3 + \sqrt{3}\) hai. Dono cases mein left side \(-\sqrt{3}\), jo right side ke barabar hai.
blocks.final_answer: Principal solutions \([0, 2\pi]\) mein: \(x = \frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{\pi}{3}, \frac{5\pi}{4}, \frac{4\pi}{3}\). General solution: \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{4} + n\pi\right\}\) \(\cup\) \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{3} + n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 10.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain. Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Kitab ke examples ki tarah hum principal solutions \([0, 2\pi]\) mein aur general solution sets ke union ki shakal mein dete hain. Aap apna kaam yahan wale hal se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
